Burning Bonds#000.src: Let's get started then! Make sure to remember what I'm about to tell you.

Burning Bonds#001.src: This here is a Feeder, which will be your best friend for raising these beauties.

Burning Bonds#002.src: Ah! Ah! No entry without a medal-

Burning Bonds#003.src: Did you have any more questions before I take my leave?

Burning Bonds#004.src: Then, let me tell you a story about losing your identity in the {p}. About burning your medallion.

Burning Bonds#005.src: You pick up the medallion off the changeling's corpse.

Burning Bonds#006.src: I'll be about! Just come find me if you need my assistance.

Burning Bonds#008.src: The child might even become more powerful than the adults, who knows!

Burning Bonds#010.src: Halt, stranger! If you value your life, do not take another step forward.
Burning Bonds#010.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#011.src: I have nothing left to give you! Leave, you and your kindred!
Burning Bonds#011.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#012.src: You're completely unscathed? You must be powerful indeed, no changeling could defeat you.
Burning Bonds#012.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#013.src: Still though, I have nothing for you. I even lack a medallion to prove my own identity...
Burning Bonds#013.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#014.src: Ah, you have lost yours too? Kindred spirits we are, dead to our worlds!
Burning Bonds#014.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#015.src: Lost to my clan, dead to my family, assumed to be a brute beast of the worst sort... I am sure you can understand, being in the same state as myself?
Burning Bonds#015.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#016.src: It is some small comfort to find one in the same situation as myself. I will not pry into you, I know the value of secrets as well as anyone. But please, will you allow me a measure of catharsis and lend me an empathetic ear so I may tell my tale?
Burning Bonds#016.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#017.src: You have returned! Now, are you willing to take a moment to listen to my tale?
Burning Bonds#017.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#018.src: The forest here is safe, I ought to return home.
Burning Bonds#018.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#020.src: Abramod... I want to come home now.
Burning Bonds#020.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#021.src: If you give me your medallion, I can be with you again.
Burning Bonds#021.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#022.src: If you can't show me your medallion, how could I know you are really you?
Burning Bonds#022.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#023.src: There are creatures that take the shape of any man, and they want to kill us! It would be ignorant to not take it with you!
Burning Bonds#023.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#024.src: Give me your medallion. I can become one of you.
Burning Bonds#024.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#025.src: You are not Lishvil. And judging by that, he disposed of his before you could get to it.
Burning Bonds#025.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#026.src: If it means you won't deceive my clan, I'll burn my medallion, like Lishvil did! You can kill me, but you will never be me!
Burning Bonds#026.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#028.src: Hyup! There, if you want it so bad, go get it!
Burning Bonds#028.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#030.src: That is my story. It is unfortunate it cannot have a happier ending, unless...
Burning Bonds#030.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#031.src: I do know how to make a new medallion, but it is a difficult task. Collecting the materials required for it would be more dangerous for my frail body than fending for myself out here...
Burning Bonds#031.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#032.src: With you however, we might be able to gather them. If you prove yourself trustworthy, I could even help you make one as well. How does that sound?
Burning Bonds#032.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#034.src: First, we will need a wooden base for the medallion.
Burning Bonds#034.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#035.src: There's an old, lightning struck tree to the south that we traditionally go to.
Burning Bonds#035.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#036.src: I will write the directions to it for you and meet you by it.
Burning Bonds#036.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#037.src: Meet Abramod near the lightning struck tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Burning Bonds#038.src: This tree was struck by lightning many generations ago. And yet it has remained standing, even after death.
Burning Bonds#038.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#039.src: The bark from it has proven sturdy enough that it works well as a medallion's base.
Burning Bonds#039.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#040.src: However it might be a bit, ah, difficult to reach. It is in part why I need your help.
Burning Bonds#040.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#041.src: I will... assist you in climbing the tree. On your way down, you will need to hit {~} of healthier branches so we have enough bark.
Burning Bonds#041.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#043.src: I'll need to stay down here so I can collect the bark as it hits the ground.
Burning Bonds#043.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#046.src: If you need time to get your bearings, I understand. Come back when you're ready!
Burning Bonds#046.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#047.src: Looks like you didn't quite hit enough branches...
Burning Bonds#047.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#049.src: Remember, you need to hit {~} healthy branches.
Burning Bonds#049.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#051.src: I understand. Talk to me again when you've caught your breath.
Burning Bonds#051.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#052.src: Good! This should be enough for the bases.
Burning Bonds#052.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#053.src: Next we'll need to collect some resin to lacquer the medallion with.
Burning Bonds#053.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#054.src: High in a mountain meadow to the east, a fern grows that excretes a resin that works well for the task.
Burning Bonds#054.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#055.src: I'll write you some instructions on how to get there and see you once you arrive.
Burning Bonds#055.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#056.src: Meet Abramod in the mountain grove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Burning Bonds#057.src: This meadow is home to a rare fern that we collect resin from to make our medallions.
Burning Bonds#057.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#058.src: Do not go searching for it just yet though! It is also home to a poisonous fern that appears very similar to the one we need.
Burning Bonds#058.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#059.src: My eyes aren't so good anymore, so I'm going to need your help to tell them apart!
Burning Bonds#059.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#060.src: I'm going to toss the plants for you. You can pick them up by right-clicking them - even while they're still in the air!
Burning Bonds#060.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#061.src: Place the greener, healthier looking plants to the side where I am now. And you'll need to burn the poisonous, more sickly looking plants on the other side.
Burning Bonds#061.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#062.src: We'll need {~} of the good ferns to extract enough resin. But make sure the poisonous ferns don't build up too much or it could be dangerous for you!
Burning Bonds#062.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#063.src: You'll only be able to pick up one at a time, so good luck!
Burning Bonds#063.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#066.src: I understand. I'll be here whenever you are.
Burning Bonds#066.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#067.src: Looks like you didn't get enough!
Burning Bonds#067.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#072.src: There's only one final thing we need: knives to cut the bark with.
Burning Bonds#072.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#073.src: Put that away, we don't need just any knife!
Burning Bonds#073.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#074.src: Tradition dictates we have to descend to a cave beneath this mountain where much of the fog of the {p} settles. Deep inside are stones we've used for generations in carving our medallions.
Burning Bonds#074.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#075.src: I'll write down the directions for you again and meet you there.
Burning Bonds#075.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#076.src: Meet Abramod outside of the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Burning Bonds#077.src: This cave here is where much of the mist pools. You can't tell from here, but it's very windy in there!
Burning Bonds#077.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#078.src: At its end is an outcrop of rock with some of the sharpest stalagmites you've ever seen formed from those harsh winds.
Burning Bonds#078.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#079.src: You'll need to head in and reach that outcrop. I'll try and call out to you if I see any bursts of wind heading your way, but you'll have to dodge them on your own!
Burning Bonds#079.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#080.src: If you get hit you'll be blown back, but try not to be blown back too far.
Burning Bonds#080.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#081.src: You can walk in once you're ready to start.
Burning Bonds#081.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#083.src: I'll meet you back at my campsite.
Burning Bonds#083.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#084.src: Thank you so much again for all the help you've granted me!
Burning Bonds#084.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#087.src: We are going to make the medallion now, are we not?
Burning Bonds#087.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#088.src: It looks like I marked out for you the spots on the medallion that have to be cut out.
Burning Bonds#088.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#089.src: All you have to do is cut them. Easy.
Burning Bonds#089.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#091.src: Good! I will drag the knife down. And you will push it in to cut!
Burning Bonds#091.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#092.src: You're not ready!? Then get ready, quickly! We do not have time to waste.
Burning Bonds#092.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#094.src: Good! Good! Look at how beautiful it is!
Burning Bonds#094.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#095.src: The intricacy! The style! With this, I will be able to get into any clan I want!
Burning Bonds#095.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#096.src: But... there is a loose end isn't there. Even if I can go anywhere I want... you will always know, won't you?
Burning Bonds#096.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#097.src: You are a danger that cannot be allowed to persist!
Burning Bonds#097.speaker: Abramod
